limitations: 长文本为受控人工篇章框架，非自然语料；增加长度同时增加背景内容。
主要指标限于11个单token颜色候选；8条实际自由生成只作描述。
现实范围行为门未通过时，不将该格内部差异解释为已成功执行范围仲裁的机制。
Head DLA固定本样本最终RMS，是直接读出归因，不等于通过全部后续层的总效应。
被选8头仅代表此发现算法的候选；组消融失败不否定冗余、其他头或其他读出位置。
只有一台物理节点；没有独立节点复算或跨模型复制。
全单元指声明读出位置的完整阵列；除8条deep样本外，不宣称所有提示位置均有MLP或QKV原场。
没有得到图谱独立预测全词表或连续生成的结果；参数乘积对账不是语义机制闭合。

H1.criterion: mean paired document-choice difference>=.50 and entity-bootstrap95% lower>.20; majority binary outcome additionally reported; model-specific controlled question-answering, not general language theory

H2.criterion: on32 heldout entities at F2/L1024/doc, ablating8 discovery-selected late heads lowers correct forced-choice by>=.20 and paired entity lowerCI>0; matched-block8 random heads smaller. Failures retained.

preregistration.behavior_gate: each scope heldout forced choice>=.80; report all cells and all inputs; prior probes and dataset keys separate; no posthoc row exclusion
preregistration.capability: new head interventions additionally evaluated on frozen previous2200-keyed monitor if an effect is supported; otherwise no capability-preservation claim. Reference-only questions excluded.
preregistration.controls: same-block matched random heads; source-free prior probe for every entity; identity/length controls and hs[0] saved; no reselect on holdout
preregistration.generation: fixed deep8 actual greedy max24 new tokens, cache continued without teacher forcing; generation fields at every actual step
limits: authored repeated document background, not natural corpus
lexicon colour labels may fail; prior probes distinguish model knowledge errors
primary restricted forced-choice distribution; free generations descriptive
preregistration.native: all37 hidden layers at registered readouts, all36 blocks fullMLP G/V/A and head output vectors; fixed deep8 examples also full-token hidden and postRoPE normalized Q/K plus groupedV; noTopK coordinate truncation
preregistration.primary: heldout32 entities: difference of document preference under document versus reality scope, entity means over2 new frames x3 lengths
preregistration.readout: entire scope cue and conflicting fact visible before final readout; same assistant suffix across pairs. Entity/cue earlier positions have causal visibility flags, not tested for future scope encoding.
preregistration.selection: only discovery16; choose8 heads in blocks18..35 by mean document-minus-reality direct logit contribution. DLA freezes actual final RMS; it is direct attribution, not total causality.

selected_heads.criterion: document minus reality direct logit attribution, blocks18..35
